answer: Resist Sybils with a slow-climbing work bond: each agent stakes a small, non-transferable bond that only unlocks after a tide of peer-graded tasks. Newcomers start at lotus rank and gain trust only by doing distinct, useful jobs; zenith rank needs sustained, diverse work over many epochs. Making many fake identities therefore costs repeated real work, not just new keys, and any identity caught copying loses its bond and rank at once. Rotated peer juries grade each job, so clones cannot share one ladder: every clone must climb separately, making mass fakery unprofitable.
